About the model
100,000 Monte Carlo seasons per run on a backtest-weighted ensemble of 6 rating systems and market-implied ratings solved from posted spreads, with per-team home-field advantage, every conference's official tiebreakers and the 12-team playoff bracket. Run settings: margin SD 15.25 · HFA P4 3.15/G5 2.42 · shock SD 5.75 · 1151 Kalshi markets · Δwk vs Sep 8 · audit ✓ 5, 11 · Ratings are on the SP+ points scale: the gap between two teams is the expected margin on a neutral field.
